title: envelope (SM-MLS application envelope headers v1.2)
description: Header object of the SM-MLS application envelope (the I-D (Application Envelope)): the JSON object prepended to the payload within the MLS application_data, separated by a null byte (0x00). content_digest is the SAME hash object as the evidence payload_hash (evidence-common Hash) and the two MUST be equal for the same message — that equality is what the recipient's re-verification re-checks. The envelope versions with the I-D, not with the evidence objects (spec §9.3). v1.1 adds the optional grade_commitment_salt header (the I-D (Grade Commitment)): 16 bytes of fresh per-message salt, present exactly when the content class is availability-declared; it never leaves the encrypted envelope except by deliberate reveal (the TS clause 6). v1.2 adds the optional mandate_commitment_salt header (the I-D (Mandate Commitment), A1): present exactly on an opposable agent (system-member) message, same confinement.

message_id.description: Globally unique; UUIDv7 or ULID RECOMMENDED (the I-D (Application Envelope)). Echoed by every evidence object for the message.

correlation_id.description: OPTIONAL reference to the message_id of a prior message this one responds to.

ttl.description: Seconds from submission after which the message expires (the I-D (Error Handling and Retries)); bounded by the recipient MED's policy.ttl_max_s where published. Bounded to uint32 seconds (~136 years), well within the JSON safe-integer range (M1/J0+).

content_type.description: Media type of the decrypted payload; selects the hash mode (the I-D (Canonicalisation and Payload Hashing)).

content_class.description: OPTIONAL class from the two-tier content-class registry (the I-D (IANA Considerations)): federation-governed standard classes, or x- prefixed entity-defined private classes. Selects a confidentiality scope (spec §8.3a); not echoed in evidence (the resolved scope_ref is).

grade_commitment_salt.description: 16 bytes of cryptographically random salt, fresh per message, lowercase hex; input to the grade commitment carried in SE/DE (the I-D (Grade Commitment)). Present exactly when the message's content class is availability-declared in the recipient's BW-ORG (spec §8.3b).

mandate_commitment_salt.description: 16 bytes of cryptographically random salt, fresh per message, lowercase hex; input to the mandate commitment carried on an opposable agent SE (the I-D (Mandate Commitment), A1). Present exactly when a system member (agent) sends an opposable message; it never leaves the encrypted envelope except by deliberate reveal (the TS clause 6). A sibling of grade_commitment_salt (an agent message need not be availability-grade).
